title: devkb: a knowledge graph of a repository for coding agents
description: devkb builds a knowledge graph of a repository's code and development process (functions, calls, tests, routes, errors, configuration, commits, pull requests, tickets) and serves it to coding agents as pre-computed context packs and as an MCP server. The repository includes the benchmark harness, the registry of benchmarked repositories, raw runs, and the study behind the paper Precomputed Context, Not More Tools: A Pre-Registered Study of Process Graphs for Coding Agents, with a script that recomputes every result.
